title: 第11章 黎清月的心思第12章 宫中危机接风宴
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: 她手握白雪，独自眺望无尽蛮荒，满天繁星的映照下，身影有种说不出的清冷。
她之一生，生于镇国王府，长于军营，战场上的厮杀拼命，是她身为镇国王府后人的使命。
大虞百姓称她为女战神，但她从不认为，因为她心底只是想守住镇国王府的荣光，不想看其凋零。
她本以为，自己会永远镇守边荒，不参与进权势争斗之中，却没想过自己站在了这个位置，已然无法左右自己的选择了。
“六皇子已经回到京城。”
“清月，您也该回去了……”
黎清月身后，一位老者身影出现，凝声开口。
他是黎清月的叔伯，曾跟随老战神征战，如今虽然不复年轻，但还有一战之力，一直追随在其身边，如此也能让王府中放心。
数日前，京中便传来口谕，召黎清月回京。
如今，六皇子已然归京，第二道口谕传来，不得不回了。
“明日我便启程。”
黎清月转身，清冷的身影，看不出喜怒哀乐。
这几日，她人虽未离去，但军中的大小事情已经交代的差不多了，此番离去，她也不知何时能回来，自需要有人接手她的位置。
对于这一点，她倒是不担心。
如今大虞鼎盛，军中能人将士涌现，她亦有可靠的心腹大将，随便一人走出，便可问将军之列。
她担心的，是镇国王府。
势大如山，虽然高耸，但若崩灭，轻易便会被海水吞没。
黎清月知道，皇命她无法违，为保家族上下，只得认定这个皇朝上下最不受宠，势力最弱小的皇子。
“你我皆是棋子，我知你命苦势薄，但你若有夺嫡之心，即便王府势微，身死我也会助你！”
黎清月抬眸，眺望着京城方向，心底暗暗许下诺言。
对于这位六皇子，她谈不上熟悉，即便是幼年在京城呆过一段岁月，也没有见过。
后来，她虽然也回过京城多次，但更不可能相见了。
因为那个时候的孟尘，已经被送入敌国为质子了。
相比于自己，黎清月觉得六皇子的命更苦一些，他这次回来，必定要卷入争斗的漩涡……
甚至，会遭遇灭杀的危险。
黎清月十分聪明，怎么会想不到这其中的因果与牵连。
“对了，明叔。”
“先传信回去，要王府中的人暗中保护六皇子，以免发生不测。”
黎清月回头，认真叮嘱道。
她即便明日启程，赶回京城也需要一些时日，六皇子势单力薄，又刚刚回来京城，恐会面临诸多麻烦与算计。
“放心，六皇子归京时，王府已经有人暗中去保护，只是消息一直没有传过来，不过如今六皇子安全回京，想来一路并无意外。”
对于孟尘遭遇截杀之事，只有幕后之人知晓，外人自然不知道具体发生了什么。
哪怕赶至现场，所有尸体都化作成了灰烬，根本无迹可查。
此事，连镇国王府都不知晓，黎清月与明叔这里，自然也不知道。
“看来，你对这个六皇子并不讨厌？”
“清月，你实话告诉我，对这位六皇子可有好感？”
“如果你心底不愿意这门婚事，就算拼了我这把老骨头，镇国王府也要对虞皇请命，退了这婚约！”
见黎清月如此关心六皇子，明叔不由有些意外。
对于赐婚这件事，黎清月一直表现的很清冷，他也猜不透其心思，这才忍不住关心问了起来。
皇命虽然不可违，但他镇国王府数代皆为皇朝征战，难道还不能婉拒这一桩婚事吗？
虽然，彻底退婚不可能，但若是改换一位皇子，还是有可能的。
毕竟，几大皇子，皆是虞皇亲子，想要指给谁，不过是虞皇的一句话而已。
在六皇子被突然下令接回来之前，所有人都以为黎清月会指给前五位皇子的。
content_en:
Holding the white snow in her hand, she looked out at the endless wilderness alone. Under the starry sky, her figure had an indescribable coldness.
She was born in the Zhenwang Palace and grew up in the military camp. Fighting on the battlefield was her mission as a descendant of the Zhenwang Palace.
The people of Dayu called her the Goddess of War, but she never thought so, because in her heart she just wanted to preserve the glory of the Zhenwang Palace and did not want to see it wither.
She originally thought that she would always guard the frontier and not participate in the struggle for power, but she never thought that she was in this position and could no longer control her own choices.
"The Sixth Prince has returned to the capital."
"Qingyue, it's time for you to go back..."
Behind Li Qingyue, an old man appeared and spoke in a solemn voice.
He is Li Qingyue's uncle. He once fought with the old God of War. Although he is no longer young, he still has the strength to fight. He has always been by his side, which can also reassure the palace.
A few days ago, an oral order came from the capital, calling Li Qingyue back to the capital.
Now, the Sixth Prince has returned to the capital, and the second oral order came, forcing him to return.
"I will set off tomorrow."
Li Qingyue turned around, her cold figure showed no emotion or joy.
Although she has not left in the past few days, most of the affairs in the army have been explained. After leaving this time, she does not know when she will come back, and she needs someone to take over her position.
She wasn't worried about this.
Now that Dayu is at its peak, talented generals have emerged in the army, and she also has reliable confidants. Anyone who walks out can be among the generals.
What she was worried about was the Zhen Wang Mansion.
It is as big as a mountain. Although it is towering, if it collapses, it will be easily swallowed by the sea.
Li Qingyue knew that she could not disobey the emperor's order. In order to protect the family, she had no choice but to identify the prince who was the least favored and the weakest in the dynasty.
"You and I are both chess pieces. I know that your fate is poor and your power is weak, but if you have the intention to seize the throne, even if the palace is weak, I will help you even if I die!"
Li Qingyue raised her eyes and looked towards the capital, secretly making a promise in her heart.
She was not familiar with the sixth prince, even though she had spent some time in the capital when she was young, she had never seen him before.
Later, although she returned to the capital many times, it was even more impossible to meet him.
Because at that time, Meng Chen had been sent to the enemy country as a hostage.
Compared to herself, Li Qingyue felt that the sixth prince's life was more miserable. When he came back this time, he would definitely be involved in the whirlpool of fighting...
There may even be a risk of extermination.
Li Qingyue is very smart, how could he not think of the cause and effect and involvement.
"By the way, Uncle Ming."
"First send a message back, asking the people in the palace to secretly protect the Sixth Prince to avoid any accidents."
Li Qingyue turned around and warned seriously.
Even if she sets off tomorrow, it will still take some time to get back to the capital. The sixth prince is weak and has just returned to the capital, so he may face a lot of troubles and plots.
"Don't worry, when the sixth prince returned to the capital, someone from the palace had secretly protected him, but the news never came. But now that the sixth prince has returned to the capital safely, there will be no surprises along the way."
Only the people behind the scenes knew about Meng Chen's interception, and outsiders naturally didn't know what happened.
Even if they rushed to the scene, all the bodies were turned into ashes, leaving no trace at all.
Not even the town king's palace knew about this matter, and Li Qingyue and Uncle Ming naturally didn't know either.
"It seems that you don't hate this sixth prince?"
"Qingyue, tell me the truth, do you have a good impression of this sixth prince?"
"If you don't want this marriage from the bottom of your heart, even if I'm an old man, the King's Palace will still ask Emperor Yu to cancel the engagement!"
Seeing Li Qingyue caring so much about the Sixth Prince, Uncle Ming couldn't help but be a little surprised.
Regarding the marriage grant, Li Qingyue had always been very cold, and he couldn't guess what she was thinking, so he couldn't help but ask with concern.
Although the emperor's order cannot be violated, he has been fighting for the emperor for generations, so why can't he still decline this marriage?
Although it is impossible to completely break off the engagement, it is still possible if a different prince is replaced.
After all, the princes are all the sons of Emperor Yu, and it is just a word from Emperor Yu to point them out to anyone.
Before the sixth prince was suddenly ordered to be brought back, everyone thought that Li Qingyue would point out the first five princes.
